title: Null control: Doha NO2 vs CCL short
hypothesis: R2 | [fuel-airspace-losers] Null control: Doha CAMS NO2 20d z-score above 1 vs Gulf-neutral cruise operator CCL (-); if the Doha NO2 -> LHA.DE short edge (hit 50 pct, validity 0) is real it should vanish here; trade short CCL 2d at 2d lag [airquality.doha.cams_no2 -> finance.CCL.log_return] (parent: R2-0061)

trade_idea.entry_rule: airquality.doha.cams_no2 rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> short CCL next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 1 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.

followup_hypothesis: R2 | [fuel-airspace-losers] Neutral control CCL reproduced the LHA.DE null (hit 50 pct, validity 0), so the Doha NO2 short edge is noise; test whether the effect is airline-specific by shorting IAG.L 3d at 1d lag on Doha CAMS NO2 20d z-score above 1 (-) [airquality.doha.cams_no2 -> finance.IAG.L.log_return] (parent: R2-0161)
